TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Abyssal Legions Faction.

Translations.Comment: 軍団 = legions. Conveys organized demonic armies with corrupted mortals fighting together.
北方 = Northmen/northern, 斧 = axe, 戦士 = warrior. Corrupted barbarian axe-wielders.
深淵の = abyssal, 戦士 = warrior. Armored fighters corrupted by abyssal influence.
竜の子 = dragon spawn/children. Corrupted dragon-like creatures with menacing tone.
騎馬兵 = cavalry/mounted warrior. Northern barbarian cavalry forces.
騎士 = knight. Heavy demonic cavalry with corrupted nobility.
猛犬 = fierce hound/war hound. Fast demonic attack beasts.
戦車 = war chariot. Brutal swift demonic vehicle of destruction.
大悪魔 = arch-devil. Greater demon lord, consistent with Abyssal Demons faction.
悪魔の子 = devil spawn. Lesser demonic creatures, consistent terminology.
戦 = war, 黒象 = black elephant/mammoth. Corrupted colossal beast of war.
大竜 = great dragon. Terrifying flying monster corrupted by abyssal forces.
マンティコア = manticore (katakana for foreign mythological term). Maintains fantasy terminology.
勇者 = champion/hero. Elite warrior with formidable power and authority.
魔導士 = sorcerer/mage. Dark magic user wielding abyssal supernatural powers.
群首 = pack leader/war leader. Barbarian warlord commanding fierce warriors.
